qa_pairs.question: What screw size and torque is specified for the support to starter?
What torque specification is used for Terminal 30h on the starter electrical leads?
What is the screw size and torque for Terminal 50?
What torque specification is required for Terminal 30?
Which terminal has the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Terminal 30 has the highest torque specification at 12 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the bolt specification for the pole tube connection?
Do all the components in section 12.41 apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all components listed under section 12.41 apply to 'All' vehicle types

qa_pairs.question: Which two components share the same M6 6 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Terminal 50 and the bolt connection for pole tube both use M6 screws with 6 Nm torque
